layer.name: 311 flooding reports
layer.description: 311 requests routed to DEP for street or highway flooding, sewer backups and water in basements, over the last twelve months. A request is a caller's report, not a finding, and one storm can bring many requests for the same spot. Requests created from 2025-11-14 on. Not on the map: 217 of 15,862 requests (no usable coordinates; highway requests rarely have them). Not added to DOB complaints, which can repeat a request. Pulled 2026-11-14.
